D\'Genius Solutions

AI Motion Graphic Designer

D’Genius Solutions seeks a creative and detail-oriented AI Motion Graphic Designer to produce high-quality social media creatives, reels, motion graphic videos, AI-generated visuals, digital ads, and promotional content. The role requires strong knowledge of AI creative tools, motion graphics, graphic design, video editing, typography, and modern digital content formats.

Section A — Multiple Choice

15 marks
1Which Adobe Creative Cloud application is primarily used for vector-based graphic design and illustration?
A. Adobe Photoshop
B. Adobe After Effects
C. Adobe Illustrator
D. Adobe Premiere Pro
2When generating images with AI tools like Midjourney or Leonardo AI, what does 'prompt engineering' refer to?
A. The process of training the AI model from scratch.
B. Writing descriptive text inputs (prompts) to guide the AI in generating specific visuals.
C. Editing the AI-generated images using Photoshop.
D. Troubleshooting errors in the AI generation software.
3In motion graphics, what is the primary purpose of easing (e.g., ease-in, ease-out)?
A. To make animations appear more robotic and mechanical.
B. To create smoother, more natural, and visually appealing movement by controlling the acceleration and deceleration of objects.
C. To increase the file size of the final video.
D. To add complex visual effects like blurs and glows.
4Which of the following is a key characteristic of vector graphics compared to raster graphics?
A. They are made up of pixels and lose quality when scaled up.
B. They are based on mathematical equations and can be scaled infinitely without losing quality.
C. They are ideal for photographic images.
D. They have larger file sizes.
5When editing a video for social media, what is generally considered the most important factor for viewer retention?
A. The length of the video.
B. The complexity of the visual effects.
C. The pacing and engagement within the first few seconds.
D. The number of different fonts used.
6Which AI tool is specifically designed for generating and editing video content from text prompts or existing images?
A. Midjourney
B. Adobe Photoshop
C. Runway / Kling AI / Pika Labs
D. Adobe Illustrator
7What does 'typography' refer to in graphic design?
A. The arrangement of visual elements in a design.
B. The art and technique of arranging typefaces (fonts) to make written language legible, readable, and appealing when displayed.
C. The use of color palettes in a design.
D. The process of creating 3D models.
8When converting AI-generated images into animated videos, what is a common challenge?
A. The AI images are too high resolution.
B. Achieving consistent motion and avoiding unnatural artifacts or 'flickering' between frames.
C. The AI images are always perfectly composed.
D. The AI tools automatically add sound effects.
9Which tool is commonly used for collaborative design and prototyping, often integrated into design workflows?
A. Adobe Premiere Pro
B. Canva
C. Figma
D. Adobe After Effects
10What is the primary function of Adobe After Effects?
A. Creating vector illustrations.
B. Editing raw video footage.
C. Compositing, animation, and creating motion graphics and visual effects.
D. Designing static social media posts.
11When designing for digital ads, what is a crucial element to consider for effective performance?
A. Using the maximum number of colors allowed.
B. A clear call-to-action (CTA) and a strong visual hook.
C. Making the ad as large as possible.
D. Including extensive background music.
12What does 'composition' refer to in visual design?
A. The choice of color palette.
B. The arrangement and relationship of visual elements within a frame or space.
C. The speed of animation.
D. The type of font used.
13Which of these AI tools is primarily known for generating realistic or stylized images from text descriptions?
A. Adobe Premiere Pro
B. Runway
C. Midjourney / Leonardo AI
D. CapCut
14For creating short, engaging videos like Instagram Reels, what is a key editing technique to maintain viewer interest?
A. Long, continuous shots with minimal cuts.
B. Fast-paced editing with frequent cuts, dynamic transitions, and engaging visuals/text overlays.
C. Using only background music without any sound effects.
D. Keeping the aspect ratio very wide.
15What is the main advantage of using AI tools like Adobe Firefly or Midjourney for concept generation?
A. They eliminate the need for any human creativity.
B. They can quickly generate a wide variety of visual ideas and styles based on prompts, accelerating the ideation process.
C. They always produce final, polished assets ready for publication.
D. They are only useful for creating abstract art.

Section B — Short Answers

3 questions
B1Describe your workflow when tasked with creating a social media reel using AI-generated elements.
B2How do you ensure brand consistency when creating creatives for different clients with distinct brand identities?
B3What is your approach to balancing creative experimentation with client/project objectives?

Section C — Long Answer

1 question(s)
C1Imagine you are asked to create a series of 5 social media posts (static and animated) for a new eco-friendly product launch. The target audience is environmentally conscious millennials. Describe in detail your creative process, including how you would leverage AI tools, what design principles you would focus on, and how you would ensure the content is engaging and aligns with the brand's sustainable message. Mention specific software or AI tools you might use.
Minimum 150 words.
